jobs.title: Business Operations and Growth Lead, Asia
jobs.description_text: The Community you will join: The Chief Business Officer (CBO) organization drives Airbnb's growth and expansion around the world, commercializing our new and existing businesses and executing our global strategy in the market. The Global Markets team sits within CBO and makes sure Airbnb is locally relevant everywhere we operate, working with regions to plan and execute growth across supply, demand, and the surfaces our communities use. Asia is one of the largest growth opportunities in that portfolio and one of the most complex regions to run: Japan, Korea, India and Southeast Asia sit at very different stages of maturity, with distinct competitive sets, regulatory contexts and consumer behaviour. Over the past year, the region has built a new operating system and scaled multiple growth levers from single-market pilots to regional programs. That growth has outpaced our capacity to run it: business reporting, program delivery and the cross-functional roadmap currently sit with one person alongside the regional strategy agenda. We are building a dedicated capability to own how Asia operates and how Asia delivers, and we want you at the centre of it. The difference you will make: This role is based in Singapore and requires regular travel across Asia. jobs.description_text: The Difference You Will Make: Airbnb is seeking a Delivery Excellence Manager to join our Community Support organization and lead a team of Team Specialists within Premium Support. This is a new, full-time people manager position based in Canada East - Remote . You will manage a team of 7-8 Team Specialists across Canada and EMEA, coaching and developing them across three areas of work: subject matter expertise, operations and administration, and projects. You will also help the team move from a small, self-organizing group to a larger, regionalized operation with more formal systems and processes, including how work is requested, assigned and tracked. You will need hands-on people management experience (coaching, performance management and developing team members), a background in customer service operations, an understanding of hospitality and premium support, and active use of AI tools in your day-to-day work. Experience leading a team through change is essential. Structured project management and data/reporting experience are key to success in this role. A Typical Day: Lead the team's subject matter expertise (SME) work as the frontline for Premium Support Build and nurture an engaged, diverse team of seven to eight Team Specialists across Canada and EMEA. Coach and uplevel Team Specialists, supporting and challenging them to meet and exceed expectations. Mentor Team Specialists into larger project management initiatives. jobs.title: Lead AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Team Our team is at the core of Avride's self-driving stack. We build the base infrastructure layer that powers all autopilot code. It includes a C++ framework for implementing autonomy components, execution graph building and optimization systems, as well as runtimes that execute those graphs, both onboard and in simulation. The vast part of the execution graph is implemented as a chain of neural network operations. The onboard mode relies on stable latencies of the inference of those networks, while in simulation we also optimize throughput at scale. About the role We’re looking for a software engineer with a leadership mindset and deep ML infrastructure experience. You will decide and influence the ML infrastructure layer across the company. The biggest challenge we’re facing at the moment is the effectiveness of GPU inference - both for onboard applications with near real-time guarantees and for offboard cases that target high throughput and deterministic execution. It is the first priority within this role. jobs.description_text: 关于我们 AXQ 安贤投资 是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。 岗位使命 作为 机器学习基础设施工程师（Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer） 你将参与建设 AXQ 面向量化研究与机器学习的计算和平台基础设施，与 Infrastructure 团队及研究、工程团队紧密合作，提升特征计算、模型训练、实验迭代与推理任务的效率和可靠性。 我们面向 PB 级数据处理与大规模机器学习训练场景，持续优化 GPU/CPU 计算资源、分布式计算、存储与数据访问、机器学习平台及开发者工具。 你将参与相关基础设施系统与平台工具的设计、开发与交付，帮助研究人员更高效地使用计算资源，让研究工作流具备可扩展、可复现、易使用和成本高效的特性。 主要职责 计算集群与任务调度 ：建设和优化 GPU/CPU 资源管理与任务调度系统，提高计算资源利用率和任务运行效率。 分布式训练与计算 ：支持多 GPU、多节点计算任务，优化数据加载、任务并行、节点通信与故障恢复。 数据访问与性能优化 ：优化大规模数据读取、缓存与存储访问，定位并改善计算、网络及 I/O 瓶颈。 机器学习平台与研究工具 ：开发任务提交、实验管理、开发环境及依赖管理工具，提升研究效率与可复现性。 训练与推理基础设施 ：支持模型训练、批量及在线推理任务的部署运行，完善版本管理、监控与故障恢复。 自动化与稳定性建设 ：建设自动化运维、监控告警、权限管理与资源配额能力，提升系统可靠性。 需求落地与使用体验 ：与研究和工程团队协作，将共性需求转化为易用、可复用的平台能力。 岗位要求 具备基础设施、平台工程、分布式系统、高性能计算或机器学习相关技术基础，能够参与模块设计、开发、部署与问题排查。 扎实的 Linux、网络、存储和操作系统基础，能够分析资源使用情况，定位性能与稳定性问题。 熟练掌握 Python、Go、C++、Rust、Java 等至少一门编程语言，具备良好的编码习惯和工程意识。 了解容器、任务调度与资源管理，了解或熟悉 Kubernetes、Slurm、Ray 或同类系统中的至少一种。 理解机器学习模型训练和推理的基本流程，有实际模型训练或相关项目经验，了解数据 I/O、计算资源和运行环境的要求。 了解 CI/CD、Infrastructure as Code、监控告警及自动化运维，重视系统的可观测性、可复现性与故障恢复能力。 具备良好的学习、沟通与协作能力，能够理解研究需求，分析技术取舍并推动方案落地。 加分项 有量化投资、对冲基金、机器学习平台或大规模研究计算平台经验。 有大规模特征工程、数据管道、分布式存储或 PB 级数据处理经验。 有模型服务、批量推理或在线推理基础设施建设经验。 有公有云、混合云资源管理与 GPU 成本优化经验。 有 GPU 集群建设、分布式训练性能调优经验，或熟悉 PyTorch Distributed、CUDA、RDMA 等相关技术。 熟悉 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI coding tools，并有将其融入开发流程或建设配套工具的实践。

jobs.title: Radiation Effects Engineer - Modeling
jobs.description_text: Radiation Effects Engineer - Modeling Astranis is bridging the digital divide by building and operating the next generation of smaller, lower-cost geostationary telecommunications satellites. As a Radiation Effects Engineer focused on modeling and theory, you will own the analytical definition of our spacecraft's radiation and charging environments, transforming physical theory into actionable design constraints. jobs.description_text: WHY BOX NEEDS YOU Box is building the industry's most trusted, secure content and AI platform.
